about: Static checks of the Gemflow runtime (gemflow check), workflow.md §4. Each case: a workflow document, optionally the tool dictionary beside it (`tools`), and the sorted severity:code list the loader must report — loadStatechart's diagnostics, then readDictionary's against the loaded statechart.
